title: From zero: the real server binary and the desktop-app stack install, join, chat and keep the message over a restart
spec: No new behaviour: an acceptance test of the newcomer path as the README gives it, Unix only. The crewcraft-server binary runs first-run with --name localhost, a fixed loopback listen port and --invitation-file, then serve, then room while serving. A desktop-app Controller with join_from_link takes the link from the invitation file, fetches the root against its fingerprint and enrolls; the TOTP secret is read from the otpauth:// URI the app shows (checked to be the default entry for the account), the current step's code confirms it and the next step's code signs in, and the signed-in room list holds the new room. The app sends a message and sees it. serve is stopped with SIGTERM (exit 0, 'CrewCraft stopped.') and started again on the same directory; the open app reports the lost connection and resumes without signing out. A Controller opened afresh on the same data folder resumes and shows the message after a sync. Wall time only; the server makes its own secrets.
